scope: Next operator candidate; no retrospective changes to frozen existing experiments.

execution_layer.question: Does implementation execute the same actual work faster?
execution_layer.state_source: Frozen baseline natural trajectories; candidate-source matched replay is a separately reported trajectory sensitivity check.
execution_layer.batch_coverage: Actual survivor states B3/B2/B1, frozen early/middle/late positions; cropped B3 rows are shape diagnostics only.
execution_layer.primary_cost: Complete call including required preparation, copies and synchronization, plus trace-weighted full attention chain estimate; not model JCT.
execution_layer.TP: Per-rank max is a proxy; application uses measured jointly running TP wall.
execution_layer.teacher_forcing: Optional separately labeled fixed-work diagnostic; never natural quality evidence.

natural_layer.question: Does the complete method save total cost while preserving task quality?
natural_layer.stop: Natural EOS with identical frozen cap; all cap/parse/service/OOM/timeout outcomes retained under frozen scoring.

statistics.resample: whole verified independent source cluster, same draws for both methods
statistics.cost_estimand: must be frozen before formal execution

prohibited_inferences: Force or crop natural outputs to equal length and call the result natural application speedup.
Remove failures or retain only common successes in the primary denominator.
Use same seed as proof of identical trajectory across methods.
Call group wall divided by total tokens per-user TPOT.
Call fixed-state attention-chain time measured model JCT.
Treat seeds, layers, ranks, requests from one document or device replicas as independent documents.
Infer application speedup directly from kernel-sum fractions or assumed perfect overlap.
